- Source: TechCrunch (https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-is-abandoning-china-after-jensen-huangs-ouster/)
- Executive Summary: Nvidia acting CEO Colette Kress confirmed the cessation of H200 AI accelerator shipments to China, ending a previous arrangement that allowed such exports under a 25% tariff regime. This decision follows the departure of CEO Jensen Huang and coincides with Nvidia's establishment of a board-level committee for national security and export compliance, addressing new restrictions on remote compute access for Chinese customers via foreign data centers.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Nvidia acting CEO Colette Kress, former CEO Jensen Huang, US Government: Ceasing H200 shipments, terminating tariff-based export deals, and strengthening board-level compliance oversight
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Alignment with intensified US compute blockade policies and new restrictions on remote data center access
* [Key Metrics] Nvidia acting CEO Colette Kress confirmed the cessation of H200 AI accelerator shipments to China, ending a previous arrangement that allowed such exports under a 25% tariff regime.
* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Nvidia has established a board-level security committee to navigate regulatory compliance and shift focus toward non-Chinese markets to mitigate revenue impact.

### HomeView Teardown: A Surprising Step Backward
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/1d2ad87f42a00ecc
- Source: iFixit News (https://www.ifixit.com/News/120317/homeview-teardown-a-surprising-step-backward)
- Executive Summary: iFixit's teardown of the Apple HomeView reveals a heavy reliance on structural adhesives for its display, speakers, and logic board, marking a regressive step in modular design. Despite recent improvements in repairability across iPad and HomePod lines, HomeView’s integration forces high-risk disassembly that frequently leads to component failure.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] iFixit; Apple Inc. (Laboratory teardown): High-strength adhesive usage prevents non-destructive access to display and logic board
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Prioritization of tight integration and structural rigidity over serviceability in the new smart home product architecture
* [Key Fact Detail] HomeView uses industrial-grade adhesives, regressing on recent repairability progress.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Shift in design strategy highlights potential conflict between tight hardware integration and right-to-repair standards.
